title: RDFR-CI: Reference Implementation, Scenario Library and Evaluation Harness
description: Version 1.3.0 is the manuscript-alignment release for RDFR-CI. It aligns the canonical five-state authority scale, explicit PASS/UNKNOWN/N/A gate semantics and priority stop, child-local delegation controls, manuscript-facing tables and figures, and claim/equation mappings. Raw SWaT files are not redistributed; labeled A1/A2 attack performance is not claimed.
notes: ARTICLE DOI: pending. Reserve the version-specific v1.3.0 Zenodo DOI before final manuscript submission. This release supersedes v1.2.1 for manuscript alignment.
